Theorem
Source: topping:page-0077, topping:page-0078 ↗ topping-gradient-flow-gradient-flow-formulation 1. ch6:6.1\group topping-gradient-flow

If $g(t)$ is a Ricci flow on a closed manifold $\mathcal M$ for $t\in [0,T]$, then $\lambda (g(t))$ is weakly increasing on $[0,T]$.

Proof

\sketch Let $0\leq a<b\leq T$, and let $f_b$ minimize (6.6.1) for $g(b)$. Solve (6.4.6) backward on $[a,b]$ with terminal value $f(b)=f_b$. The monotonicity of $\mathcal F$ gives

\[ \lambda (g(a))\leq \mathcal F(g(a),f(a)) \leq \mathcal F(g(b),f(b))=\lambda (g(b)). \]

□
